name: @niivue/nv-ext-tiff
description: Stream pyramidal/tiled (OME-)TIFF and SVS whole-slide images into NiiVue's NVSlide by HTTP Range, decoded with geotiff
comment:niivue-peer: A literal range, not workspace:* (which bun publish pins to the exact current rc), so one release accepts later niivue rcs and 1.x. devDependencies keeps workspace:* for local dev. rc.87 adds the signal argument to fetchTileBytes; raise the floor when this package needs a newer niivue API.
